newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STYL RAISES CAPITAL VIA RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: STYL RAISES CAPITAL VIA RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Hungarian garment factory Styl Ruhagyar Rt will raise its 1.18 billion forint issued share capital to 1.77 billion forints via a rights issue, the company said in a statement.
In the issue the company will give shareholders free of charge one new share for every two they hold by capitalising 590 million forints of its reserves, it added.
The company added it lodged its request to a court to register the increased capital on June 27.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Styl shares finished at 1,200 forints on June 25, the last they were traded.
